cases.idea_text: Community event series raising funds to host the next Refresh Rochester gathering. Offers free beer, soda, and networking for local tech and creative professionals.
BOMB (Beyond Organizing Movement Building) Summer Institute: A program for CUNY students to develop skills necessary to create change at CUNY through organizing and activism training.
Build a fusor (fusion reactor) inside a common store-bought bubblegum machine. Educational DIY science project demonstrating nuclear fusion in an unconventional, accessible format.
IVIOU: A platform combining eBay and YouTube—users can play videos, view products, and buy items directly. Video-commerce marketplace for online buying and selling.
telegraph21: A curated video space focused on non-fiction storytelling and art from around the world. Helps filmmakers promote their work through a dedicated distribution platform.
Like Clockwork: Handmade word clocks made of solid wood and glass. Each clock is custom-made, measuring 17"x17" or 6"x6", displaying time through illuminated words instead of traditional hands.
Kilojoules: A fitness app that simplifies calorie counting into a science. Tracks nutrition, exercise, and daily caloric intake with data-driven insights for health-conscious users.
ValetSmartz: 'The Anywhere Valet'—a mobile personal service app for NYC. On-demand valet services accessible via smartphone for urban professionals needing convenience.

One Way Designated Drivers On Demand: An Uber-like app to reduce DUI deaths by providing on-demand designated drivers. Includes options for scooters, BART, buses, volunteers, and employee programs with driver return technology.

Fixers' Collective: A social experiment in improvisational fixing and mending. Weekly Thursday meetings (6–9pm) at Proteus Gowanus where people repair items together, promoting sustainability and community skill-sharing.

NYC Resistor hackerspace expansion: A creative technology space in Brooklyn for learning, sharing, and making things. Moving to a new location with 3x the space to accommodate growing community of makers and hackers.

Power Laces: Self-tying shoelaces inspired by 'Back to the Future' future tech. Improves life for people with motor disabilities while appealing to 80s nostalgia. Automated lacing system for hands-free convenience.

TattooTree: A gamified tattoo discovery app. Users 'plant' a TattooTree, 'feed' it with preferences, and 'pick' the fruit when ready—matching users with tattoo designs and artists through an interactive experience.
CLEX: '4 in 1' smart device combining PC, car jump starter, power bank, and flashlight. Marketed as the world's first multi-function portable smart device for automotive and mobile power needs.

Noon Design Studio: The only natural dye production house in the US. Uses new technology to turn natural materials (pomegranate, walnuts, madder root) into naturally dyed fabrics for designers and artists at industrial scale.

JP1971 MxNM: Mix and Match MIDI Pad for Apple iPad. Leverages iPad's platform for innovative musical expression, allowing musicians to create custom MIDI controller layouts for live performance and production.

Understand Your Schizophrenic: A free iPhone app that records 'word salad' speech from schizophrenic individuals and visualizes it on a graph. Aims to help caregivers and clinicians track symptom patterns.

McCallum High School Bubbles: Interactive outdoor seating structures designed and built by students. The illuminated 'bubbles' light up at night, creating functional art and social spaces for the school community.

Pinz: Location-based communication app requiring no contact list. Users can send messages to nearby people ('Hey Pinzer, like to dance?' or 'I have a flat tire, any Pinzer in the area?') for spontaneous local interactions.

velosynth: An open-source bicycle interaction synthesizer. Interprets bicycle speed and acceleration into expressive audio feedback, turning cycling into a musical instrument. Creative Commons-licensed and hackable.
The Thinket Now: A fidget and stress-reliever device delivering 'satisfying-bounce' and 'reassuring-thud' tactile feedback. Made in the USA, designed for stress relief during life's adventures.

Live View!: Social Media Live TV & Radio Application. Brings television and radio forum capabilities to the masses through social media integration, enabling live broadcasting and streaming for everyday users.
My Space, please!!: A car safety gadget that warns when the vehicle behind isn't keeping safe distance. Alerts drivers to potential rear-end collision risks when sudden braking is needed.

@party: Keeping the demoscene spirit alive in North America. Raising funds for 2011 site reservation and 501(c)(3) registration. Annual computer art event celebrating demo culture and creative coding.

Convex Trowel: A new universal concrete hand tool with utility patent #7,543,349. Designed for perfect concrete finishes, targeting landscapers and construction workers. Seeking manufacturing and distribution partnership.
EcoCharge: Solar-powered portable charger with foldable panels and built-in battery. Targets campers and travelers needing off-grid power for phones and small devices.
MealMinder: Smart fridge camera that tracks food expiry dates and suggests recipes based on ingredients about to spoil. Reduces household food waste through AI-powered notifications.
PedalPulse: Bicycle helmet with integrated turn signals and brake lights controlled by handlebar sensors. Improves cyclist visibility and safety in urban traffic conditions.
StudySync: Collaborative study app that matches students with similar courses and schedules for virtual group study sessions. Includes shared whiteboard and screen-sharing features.
AquaPure Bottle: Self-cleaning water bottle using UV-C LED technology to purify water in 60 seconds. Targets hikers and travelers in areas with questionable water quality.
PetPal Translator: AI-powered device that claims to interpret dog barks and cat meows into human language. Uses machine learning trained on animal vocalizations and body language.
GardenGuard: Automated plant monitoring system with soil moisture sensors and smartphone alerts. Waters plants automatically when moisture levels drop below optimal thresholds.
FitSwap: Fitness class exchange platform where users trade unused gym class credits with others in their city. Peer-to-peer marketplace for fitness reservations.
ModuDesk: Modular standing desk system with interchangeable components (monitor arms, cable trays, storage drawers). Users customize layout based on workspace needs.
SleepScore Alarm: Smart alarm clock that tracks sleep cycles using non-contact radar and wakes users at optimal light sleep phase. Includes ambient light simulation for gradual waking.
CodeCanvas: Visual programming environment for teaching kids Python through drag-and-drop blocks that generate real code. Bridges gap between block-based and text-based coding.
LocalLoop: Neighborhood skill-sharing app where residents offer services (tutoring, repairs, cooking) to neighbors within walking distance. Builds community through micro-exchanges.
ThermoMug: Coffee mug with precise temperature control via smartphone app. Maintains beverage at exact desired temperature for up to 2 hours using rechargeable base.
AirPure Mask: Reusable face mask with replaceable HEPA filters and built-in air quality sensor. Alerts wearer when filter needs changing or pollution levels are high.
BookBuddy: Children's reading companion device that listens to kids read aloud and provides encouragement. Uses speech recognition to track progress and suggest appropriate books.
ParkEasy: App that predicts parking spot availability using historical data and real-time user reports. Helps drivers find open spots faster in crowded urban areas.
FlexiFrame: Adjustable picture frame system that accommodates multiple photo sizes without changing mats. Uses sliding borders and magnetic mounts for easy photo swaps.
VoiceVault: Secure password manager that uses voice biometrics instead of master passwords. Users authenticate by speaking personalized passphrase patterns.
CycleSafe: Smart bike lock with GPS tracking and automatic alert if bike is moved without phone nearby. Includes 100dB alarm and 30-day battery life.
RecipeRadar: Meal planning app that generates weekly menus based on dietary restrictions, budget, and local grocery sales. Auto-creates shopping lists organized by store aisle.
LumiLantern: Solar-powered camping lantern with wireless phone charging and emergency SOS beacon. Collapsible design fits in backpack side pocket.
PosturePro: Wearable sensor that vibrates when user slouches and tracks posture habits over time. Syncs with app to show improvement trends and ergonomic tips.
ArtisanBox: Monthly subscription box featuring handcrafted tools and materials from local artisans. Each box includes video tutorials and artist stories.
NoiseNest: White noise machine with adaptive soundscapes that adjust based on room noise levels. Uses microphones to detect disturbances and mask them automatically.
TaskTally: Gamified task management app where users earn points for completing chores and goals. Points unlock real rewards through partner businesses and gift cards.
